description: Resolve exact or explicitly fuzzy scientific names, or search one vernacular name as a whole recorded common name or, with vernacularMatch: "contains", as part of one. Names default to marine and extant taxa; vernacular cannot filter. Resume scientific segments with nextInputOffset and nextMatchOffset against unchanged names and options; inputIndex preserves duplicates and partialGroup identifies split groups. For vernacular, consume nextResultOffset within the same upstream offset before advancing page.nextOffset and resetting resultOffset to zero. Full 50-match upstream groups remain completeness-unknown; accepted-name fields do not choose an ambiguous match.

extantOnly.description: Filter scientific names to extant taxa; vernacular cannot filter and rejects false.

fuzzy.description: Explicit fuzzy scientific-name matching; unavailable for vernacular.

inputOffset.description: Zero-based original scientific names position; inactive for vernacular.

marineOnly.description: Filter scientific names to marine taxa; vernacular cannot filter and rejects false.

matchOffset.description: Zero-based match within the scientific-name group at inputOffset; inactive for vernacular.

names.description: Nonempty original scientific-name list, with no total-input ceiling; at most 50 positions fetched per call. Resubmit unchanged with continuation offsets, preserving duplicates.

offset.description: Vernacular only: one-based upstream starting record, advancing by 50; default 1. Scientific names accept only 1.

resultOffset.description: Zero-based match within the fetched vernacular page; keep upstream offset until consumed. Inactive for scientific names.

vernacular.description: Common name, mutually exclusive with names; blank means unset.

vernacularMatch.description: Vernacular only: exact matches a whole recorded common name; contains matches every recorded common name containing the text, such as grouper in Nassau grouper. Names accept only exact; blank means exact.

name: worms_resolve_taxon

budgetLimited.description: Whether the byte budget ended this local page early.

deferredCount.description: Original input positions not fully consumed.

extantOnly.description: Effective extant filter, null when unsupported.

marineOnly.description: Effective marine filter, null when unsupported.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_rejected`: HTTP 400/422 rejected the inputs. `upstream_rate_limited`: Upstream rate limit or local queue overflow. `upstream_access_denied`: Keyless upstream denies access. `upstream_unavailable`: Network, server, or HTML failure. `upstream_timeout`: Request or whole-tool deadline expired. `invalid_upstream_response`: Malformed or incompatible upstream response. `response_too_large`: Upstream response exceeds 8 MiB. `invalid_selector`: Both or neither selector was supplied, or vernacular is exactly "." or "..". `unsupported_mode_options`: Options cannot apply to the selected matching mode. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextInputOffset.description: Next original names position; resubmit unchanged names and options.

nextMatchOffset.description: Next match position at nextInputOffset; null when names consumed.

nextResultOffset.description: Next local position; null when consumed.

notice.description: Empty vernacular-page guidance, or the inputIndex of each returned 50-match scientific-name group, whose completeness is unknown, with the change that narrows it.

oversizedItem.description: One indivisible scientific item exceeds the target; retained intact with forward progress.

hasMore.description: False if exhausted; null if unknown.

requiredBytes.description: Serialized paired-surface result bytes for an oversized item, excluding transport-added metadata.

resultOffset.description: Zero-based starting position in the complete local sequence.

matchOffset.description: Starting match position in the original group.

matches.description: All returned matches in source order.

aphiaId.description: Positive safe-integer AphiaID; obtain from worms_resolve_taxon.

partialGroup.description: This segment does not contain the entire fetched group.

returnedCount.description: Whole scientific items returned on this segment.

totalCount.description: Known local sequence length before pagination.
